name: pi-cache-warmer
description: Keeps the Anthropic/Claude prompt cache warm across idle periods in the pi coding agent. Anthropic's default prompt-cache TTL is 5 minutes: if no request reads a cached prefix within that window it expires. This extension replays the last real provider request with max_tokens=1 shortly before the TTL would lapse, reading (and thus refreshing) the same cached prefix without spending a full turn.
